<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Tremor](/Feats.aspx?ID=4224) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 26

</column>

---

You unleash a small, localized tremor in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31). Earth and stone in the area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) until the start of your next turn.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d8.
name: Tremor
